description: Opt-in framework-assumption layer over rules-static-v1, rules-static-closure-v1 and rules-static-reflexion-v1: reviewer-signed rows saying that a framework binds a caller to a callee no indexer can see -- a net/http mux registered through an init()-time registry, a Laravel container binding or facade accessor Larastan cannot type, a FastAPI Depends -- each naming its framework, its mechanism and the file:line it stands for, and each carried by a document bound to one index and to one commit with an expiry. The rows are ADDITIVE: they feed static_edge_assumed, a relation of its own, and never widen static_edge, which call_graph_closed completes. static_reaches_assumed is reachability over the resolved graph plus those edges, and every verdict read off it is reported as a separate *_assumed row, because an assumed edge is somebody's say-so about a framework, not something the index exhibited. Its own witnesses: assumptions_closed (the reviewer says the set is complete and every row was applied) and call_graph_closed_assumed (that, and every unresolved call site in the scope discharged by a reviewed row for that exact site).
